country.evidence_quote: Interns 4-Good was founded in 2019 by Ellie Zimmerman, then a high school sophomore, after she struggled to find meaningful internships as a teen. She built a platform where students gained real-world skills in graphic design, web development, marketing, writing, and education — while nonprofits across the U.S. received free, skilled support. Entirely student-run. Entirely built on passion.
